# Prepzo

Prepzo is a NEET preparation platform for students in India.

## Public study tools

- NEET 2026 Countdown: https://www.prepzo.study/tools/neet-countdown
- Free NEET Pomodoro Timer: https://www.prepzo.study/tools/pomodoro
- Study Tools Directory: https://www.prepzo.study/tools

The countdown tracks the official NEET UG 2026 re-examination scheduled for June 21, 2026.
The Pomodoro timer supports adjustable focus sessions, short and long breaks, daily study goals,
local progress saving, light mode, and dark mode.

## Official exam source

- National Testing Agency NEET website: https://neet.nta.nic.in/

## About Prepzo

Prepzo provides NEET MCQ practice, flashcards, spaced repetition, progress tracking, and free
browser-based study tools.
